resumeText:
Ananya Sharma | Gurugram | ananya.sharma@example.com

SUMMARY
Hotel revenue professional with 6 years across reservations and rooms revenue for business hotels.

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Revenue Manager, Aravali Business Hotel, Gurugram (2022 - present)
- Set daily room rates and length of stay restrictions for a 250-room business hotel.
- Load rates and inventory on OTAs through the STAAH channel manager and check rate parity every morning.
- Build the 90-day rooms forecast using pickup and pace reports from Opera.
- Review the weekly STR report and compset rate shopping with the sales team.
- Built Excel dashboards to track daily revenue, ADR and RevPAR.
- Present the weekly revenue meeting to the general manager, director of sales and front office manager.

Reservations Executive, Cyber City Suites, Gurugram (2020 - 2022)
- Handled corporate and group room reservations and room blocks for events.

SKILLS
IDeaS G3 (training only), Opera PMS, MS Excel, PowerPoint

EDUCATION
BBA in Hospitality Management, New Delhi (2020)
